package_name: Parvati Valley Hidden Villages (4D) — Malana, Kalga & Pulga

itinerary.day_1: Bhuntar → Kasol → Malana (Drive: 35 km + trek). Places: Kasol, Malana Village. Activities: Kasol check-in; Malana ancient democracy village; Forest trail return.
itinerary.day_2: Tosh Village Trek (Drive: 15 km + trek). Places: Tosh. Activities: Drive to Barshaini; 2hr hike to Tosh (2,400m); Epic valley views.
itinerary.day_3: Kalga & Pulga (Drive: Local). Places: Kalga, Pulga, Chalal. Activities: Kalga forest trail; Pulga — final outpost; Chalal riverside bonfire.
itinerary.day_4: Return to Bhuntar (Drive: 35 km). Places: Manikaran Sahib. Activities: Manikaran Sahib morning; Hot spring kitchen; Depart Bhuntar.
